items.title: Update to ArcGIS Pro Product Life Cycle
items.summary: Beginning with the release of ArcGIS Pro 3.8 (November 2026), we are updating the ArcGIS Pro product life cycle (PLC) to make software support easier to understand, simplify upgrade planning, and improve alignment with the ArcGIS Enterprise life cycle.

items.title: How the GNIS Lake Ontario/Lake America name change in the U.S. will appear in Maps
items.summary: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has formally changed the name for "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" in the United States.

items.title: Planetary prediction engine: Automating global models via Earth AI
items.summary: Rama Pasumarthi, Staff Software Engineer, and Shravya Shetty, Distinguished Engineer, Google Research As part of Google Earth AI , we introduce the planetary prediction engine (PPE), an experimental research capability that autonomously executes the full geospatial modeling workflow — from data discovery to model training — achieving improvements across diverse prediction tasks in public health, food security, environmental risk, and socioeconomics.

items.title: Building Claude Commerce Agents
items.summary: AI is rapidly changing commerce, and consumer brands and platforms are on the move to respond. In today's webinar, Ali Shazal will walk you through our new blueprints for consumer and merchant agents.

items.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
items.summary: How a two-person leadership team uses ChatGPT Work to run 26 events nationwide, improve visibility in AI search, and inventory merch in minutes.

items.title: Introducing WeatherNext 3, our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model
items.summary: Our flagship AI weather forecasting model now includes real-time satellite data, hourly refreshes, higher resolution, precise precipitation forecasting, and clean energy variables.

items.title: Proactive cyber defense for governments and enterprises
items.summary: Today, we’re launching our Fairwind Program, a limited access program for governments and trusted partners to use our most advanced cyber defense capabilities.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.summary: Our newest Gemini models deliver next-generation intelligence for agentic workflows and cybersecurity.

items.title: Facilitating AI integration with simplicity at scale
items.summary: As companies scale, the technology supporting operations can become a liability just as quickly as it becomes an asset.
